name: session-status
description: Evidence-based status prefixes for local Codex session titles, with a skill, MCP tools and lifecycle context hooks.

interface.longDescription: Keep the current task state visible in a Codex chat title. Preview, read and update a status prefix while preserving the topic. Hooks remind the agent to choose labels from verified results.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Session Status to keep this chat title aligned with the actual task state.
